title: Basic Commands [mv]
description:
# mv
---
mv stands for move. It has two uses, moving files, and renaming them.
To move a file, you can just run `mv FILEPATH NEWPATH`, and to rename, you can just `mv FILEPATH NEWPATHWITHNEWNAME`
Steve switched banks! We need to archive his fraud report. Move fraud/reports.txt to archive/steve_report.txt. Make sure you submit in the root of the project files.
